latency_reconciliation.earlier_narrative_204s_attribution: The 204s duration cited in narrative belonged to an earlier interactive streaming curl probe on full INTEGRATE instructions, not the runner execution of Seat 1.
latency_reconciliation.stage_matrix_bug_root_cause: build_cross_case_seat_record filtered latency_ms only from response_events (events with response_metadata=True). On an exception, response_metadata was not set, resulting in an empty latency list [].

logical_vs_physical_separation.accounting_clarification: The figure '5 total HTTP attempts' previously reported was derived from 2 observed preflight HTTP requests + 3 upper-bound permitted attempts (len(events) * (1 + SDK_MAX_RETRIES)) from SDK configuration. No per-attempt httpx wire logging was active. The physical HTTP attempts on Seat 1 cannot be distinguished between 1 and 3.
